quotes.text: Compliance can't be treated like a linear to do list with a set endpoint. Regulations form moving targets and addressing them requires movement in return.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Frames compliance as a moving target that needs an adaptive process rather than a finished checklist.

quotes.text: Risk doesn't appear only when an event happens. Sometimes the problem is in what didn't happen, like a policy review that never got done. If you wait for someone to act, compliance fails by default.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Explains why scheduled checks beat purely event-driven flows for compliance.

quotes.text: Every failed check, every exception, every escalation is actually a clue about where the system is weak or the process is broken.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Argues that automation logs are a learning signal, not just audit records.

quotes.text: It's about managing them with the same discipline as any other enterprise system. Without governance, automation becomes noise. With governance, it becomes sustainable infrastructure.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Concise case for governing flows at scale.

quotes.text: So don't think in terms of ticking boxes, think in terms of building feedback driven loops that keep your compliance alive and evolving.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters

chapters.title: Recurrence triggers as the compliance engine

takeaways: Static compliance checklists break as regulations change, so automation built around them only hardcodes the rigidity.
Recurrence triggers and logged results in SharePoint, Dataverse or Power BI turn compliance checks into a feedback loop that improves each cycle.
Naming conventions, centralized logging, templates and modular, metadata-driven flows keep compliance automation manageable as it scales.
hook: Compliance checklists go stale the moment a regulation changes. This episode shows IT and compliance teams how to use Power Automate recurrence triggers, feedback loops and governance to build a living compliance system that keeps itself current.
